description: This file defines the StreamConsumerGrainContextAction class which implements the IConfigureGrainContext interface for configuring grain contexts with stream consumer extensions in Orleans.

classes.name: StreamConsumerGrainContextAction
classes.description: Implements IConfigureGrainContext to install stream consumer extensions on grains implementing IStreamSubscriptionObserver.

methods.name: StreamConsumerGrainContextAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with an IStreamProviderRuntime instance.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the grain context by installing stream consumer extension if applicable.

methods.name: InstallStreamConsumerExtension
methods.description: Private helper that binds the StreamConsumerExtension to the grain context if an IStreamSubscriptionObserver is present.
